text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, who conquered the decisive 
battle. She and Air Groove praise each 
other's valiant efforts and vow to run a 
race even greater than today's once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, in front of the roaring crowd, 
Mejiro Dober proudly proclaimed that she 
would usher in a new era for the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of Mejiro Dober and Mejiro 
Bright had become something that everyone 
now praised as the "new glory of the 
Mejiros."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, their era had only just begun. 
The glorious path forged by Mejiro Dober 
and Mejiro Bright was set to continue 
onwards—
